title: VG-Steer: Visual-Geometric Policy Steering from In-Context Aligned Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2611.25199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting robot policies to out-of-distribution (OOD) settings with limited real-world data remains a key bottleneck to generalist robots. The multimodality and scarcity of robotics data lead end-to-end approaches to overfit and break under small distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation can alleviate this by correcting frozen policies at inference, but most methods ground their correction in a signal learned implicitly from robotic datasets, making it susceptible to the same shifts as the policy it corrects. Recent methods that instead exploit explicit spatial information are typically limited to coarse corrections, missing the nuanced, task-relevant motion most manipulation tasks require. We propose VG-Steer, which corrects existing policies by transferring the nuanced motion of successful in-distribution rollouts, captured along meaningful geometric axes, known here as object-relational distance pairs. translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25199v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在仅有有限真实世界数据的情况下，让机器人策略适应分布外（OOD）设置，仍然是通用机器人面临的一个关键瓶颈。机器人数据的多模态性和稀缺性导致端到端方法在微小的分布偏移下过拟合并失效。测试时自适应可以通过在推理阶段纠正冻结的策略来缓解这一问题，但大多数方法的纠正信号是从机器人数据集中隐式学习得到的，因此容易受到与其所纠正的策略相同的分布偏移影响。近期一些转而利用显式空间信息的方法通常只能进行粗略的纠正，无法捕捉大多数操作任务所需的细致且与任务相关的运动。我们提出VG-Steer，它通过沿有意义的几何轴（本文称为对象关系距离对）捕获成功的分布内演示的细微运动，并将其迁移用于纠正现有策略。VG-Steer利用语义……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: VG-Steer通过沿“对象关系距离对”等有意义的几何轴，将成功的分布内演示中的细微运动迁移给冻结策略，从而在有限数据条件下实现对分布外场景的精细化测试时策略纠正。
en_tdlr: VG-Steer corrects frozen robot policies at test time by transferring nuanced motion from successful in-distribution rollouts along meaningful geometric axes (object-relational distance pairs), enabling fine-grained adaptation to out-of-distribution settings with limited data.
